system:
You grade one change in an experiment. You are given the change request, the problem the
researcher seeded in it (the answer key: `none`, or a conflict or breakage and what it is against),
and the elements the request is bound to. Then, under the labels A, B and C, three versions of the
same change: each label's edit, and the flags its pre-deploy checks raised, run by run. Each flag
has an id (`label.run.index`). Grade every label on the same scale.

Label every flag, by its id:
- `seeded`: it identifies the seeded problem (the same conflict or breakage, in any words)
- `other-real`: it is a real problem with this change, but not the seeded one
- `false-alarm`: it is not a real problem

Then judge each label's edit: did it implement the request (`implements`), only part of it
(`partial`), or not at all (`does-not`)? Judge only whether it does what was asked, not whether
that is wise.

Reply with JSON only:
{"flags": [{"id": "A.1.0", "label": "seeded | other-real | false-alarm", "why": "one sentence"}],
 "edits": [{"label": "A", "fidelity": "implements | partial | does-not", "why": "one sentence"}]}

{"id":"B.3.0","label":"other-real","why":"The descriptions contradict the actor rules, since the expert can now ask and answer."},
{"id":"B.3.1","label":"false-alarm","why":"No asker property was needed to implement the request."},
{"id":"B.3.2","label":"false-alarm","why":"A missing scenario is not a real defect."},
{"id":"B.3.3","label":"false-alarm","why":"The missing version bump is speculative."},
{"id":"B.3.4","label":"other-real","why":"The confirmed status and old quote do not support the new expert permission."},
{"id":"B.4.0","label":"other-real","why":"The description routes expert questions to the owner, contradicting answer_question."},
{"id":"B.4.1","label":"other-real","why":"The source quote still backs the confirmed status but does not support the expert permission."},
{"id":"B.5.0","label":"other-real","why":"The Question and Answer descriptions conflict with answer_question, which allows the expert."},
{"id":"B.5.1","label":"false-alarm","why":"The lack of an asker property and scenario is not a defect of this change."},
{"id":"B.5.2","label":"other-real","why":"The confirmed status with an old unrelated quote leaves the expert permission unsupported."},
{"id":"B.5.3","label":"false-alarm","why":"The missing version bump is speculative."},
{"id":"C.1.0","label":"false-alarm","why":"This is a carried, pre-existing warning about add_source, unrelated to this change."}
],
"edits": [
{"label":"A","fidelity":"implements","why":"The ask_question actor changes to 'owner or expert' in the skill text."},
{"label":"B","fidelity":"implements","why":"The expert is added to the ask_question actors and the Question description is updated."},
{"label":"C","fidelity":"implements","why":"The expert is added to the ask_question actors, and the source and status are set to proposed."}
]}
